name: OmaLangy
author: BlackCode
description: OmaLangy: keyboard languages for the Omarchy bar. English, Arabic and every xkb layout, switched with a click or an Omarchy-safe shortcut

barWidget.description: Current keyboard language; click to add, remove, or switch languages

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows for the current language.

schema.label: Switch keys
schema.description: Key press that cycles languages, handled by the keyboard itself. Alt+Shift and Ctrl+Shift are not offered because Omarchy and terminals already use them.

schema.label: Next language shortcut
schema.description: Hyprland keybinding for the next language. Left off automatically if Omarchy or your bindings.lua already use it. Empty turns it off.

schema.label: Open panel shortcut
schema.description: Hyprland keybinding that opens this panel. Left off automatically on a conflict. Empty turns it off.
